gloss: rise and fall; prosperity and decline

definitions.gloss: rise and fall; prosperity and decline
definitions.explanation: The cycle of flourishing and declining, especially of nations, dynasties, or civilizations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{帝国|ていこく}→帝国：12420_teikoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{興亡|こうぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: To study the rise and fall of empires.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{興亡|こうぼう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}し→繰り返し：10320_kurikaeshi⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: History is a repetition of the rise and fall of nations.

examples.japanese: {興亡|こうぼう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}り{返|かえ}る→振り返る：04231_furikaeru⟧。
examples.english: To look back on the history of rise and fall.

notes:
{興亡|こうぼう} describes the cycle of rising to power and falling into decline, typically used for nations, empires, or civilizations.

FORMS:
{興|こう} (rise/prosper) + {亡|ぼう} (perish/decline) = rise and fall

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{興亡|こうぼう}: the rise and fall of a nation
- ⟦{帝国|ていこく}→帝国：12420_teikoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{興亡|こうぼう}: the rise and fall of an empire
- {興亡|こうぼう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧: history of rise and decline
- {興亡|こうぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧: to repeat cycles of rise and fall

REGISTER:
Literary/formal. Common in historical writing and academic texts.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{盛衰|せいすい}→盛衰：05569_seisui⟧: rise and decline (prosperity and decay)
- ⟦{栄枯|えいこ}→栄枯：08133_eiko⟧: prosperity and decline
